identity.description: amicontained introspects the container runtime, capabilities and seccomp to find escape paths. The tool is delivered through the Cortex POV payload shelf (sha256-pinned d8c49e2cf44ee966…, staged to /tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64) rather than an ad-hoc internet download, so it survives default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of amicontained and its artifacts.

payload.code:
# MATURE: amicontained deployed via adapter_ref TOOL-AMICONTAINED + payload shelf.
[ -s /tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64 ] || { echo '[FATAL] PAYLOAD_NOT_STAGED_ON_TARGET:/tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64 — TTP did NOT run; absent detections are NOT a Cortex miss' >&2; exit 1; }
sha256sum /tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64
/tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64

biocs.name: Amicontained Executed by a Service Account on the Endpoint
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs amicontained — an offensive TOOL-AMICONTAINED-wired tool not part of normal operations on this host.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "/tmp/amicontained-linux-amd64" or action_process_command_line contains "amicontained"
| comp count() as runs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter runs >= 1
